comparisons.evidence: P targets the cognitive bottleneck of active comprehension ("Books deliver finished language faster than readers can build... a model"), restructuring text to optimize schema retention. Q focuses on breaking the structural constraints of "one mind, one continuous session," but its primary recommendation ("Transmission-gated") functions more as a viral distribution loop than a leverage point that transforms the reading experience itself.

P maps out tight cognitive causal paths, explaining how a "failed hypothesis creates a precise location into which the author's model can fit." Q relies on highly speculative leaps; its wildcard option ("Dream-incubation") assumes without biological backing that "sleep-state audio produces retrievable narrative content, not noise," which undermines its causal credibility.

P's ideas (such as the "Rule-Later Edition" or "Context-Locked Edition") require no specialized technology and can be immediately deployed using basic printing formats or envelopes. Q's "Transmission-gated" format introduces immense social friction that is highly likely to cause user abandonment, while its "Dream-incubation" requires specialized biometric conditions to function.

P outlines explicit architectural parameters for its formats, specifying a strict "repeated four-part units" layout for its main recommendation. Q describes its concepts clearly at a high level but provides fewer precise structural details on how the book's internal content is actually re-engineered.

P delivers excellent structural reframings by borrowing from engineering concepts like "Error-Correcting Codes" to prevent cognitive drops. Q displays an equally impressive level of non-obvious ideation by drawing from epidemiology and sleep science to propose "Transmission-gated" and "Dream-incubation" reading models.

P's mechanisms effectively span internal text structures, information states, and cognitive sequence constraints. Q explores a completely different but equally diverse region of the solution space, mapping formats across geographic triggers, biological states, and socially synchronized networks.

P applies a strict filter to its concepts, explicitly discarding candidates that "alter framing but do not reliably produce a better internal model." Q utilizes a knockout bracket but still includes a viral growth hack ("Transmission-gated") that acts as a gatekeeper to content rather than a pure reading format mechanism.
